2014_spells.burning-hands.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
2014_spells.burning-hands.effectSummary: Deal 3d6 fire damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.burning-hands.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, as you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
